mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing the cost of capital for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 6.5%) signals economic weakness that reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE > 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and real sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle, defined by rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL > 2%, signals higher discount rates for equity valuation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) level signals strong economic output, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when INDPRO is above its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 135000) indicates a healthy labor market that boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS > 135000.

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing the cost of capital for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST > 800) signals sustained consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST > 800.
